d: Do. vikas divyakirti ke is vidiyo men satyanishtha (Integrity), eemandari (Honesty) aur shuchita (Probity) shabdon ka arth va antar spasht kiya gaya hai. iska sanbandh ethiks khand (samany adhyayan pepar-4) se hai. samany tatha prashasnik jivan ke udaharnon ko aadhar banakar is vidiyo men spasht kiya gaya hai ki naitik mulyon ke sandarbh men prayukt hone vale in tinon shabdon men kya sanbandh va antar hai.
